name: Holonet
summary:
Work, play, and share immersive experiences with others.

You can appear as a standard avatar, or take it to the next level by connecting your headset to your laptop (download the desktop app at www.holonet.world) and stepping into the space as a real-time hologram.

Whether you want to hold a meeting, take the stage, explore hidden tourist destinations, or just chill in a cool setting and play some games in good company—we got you covered.
